name: trilha-vendor
description: Builds assets/vendor/*.js from pinned npm packages. Run: npm ci && npm run build

scripts.build: mkdir -p ../assets/vendor/ort && cp node_modules/@huggingface/transformers/dist/ort-wasm-simd-threaded.jsep.mjs node_modules/@huggingface/transformers/dist/ort-wasm-simd-threaded.jsep.wasm ../assets/vendor/ort/ && esbuild ai-entry.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --platform=browser --target=es2022 --outfile=../assets/vendor/ai.js && esbuild claude-entry.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --platform=browser --target=es2022 --outfile=../assets/vendor/anthropic.js
